title: 中国科技估值便宜：瑞银却更谨慎，催化剂在哪？
speaker: Adrian Zuercher

segments.en: How constructive are you in Chinese tech? Because we have Cambricorn releasing earnings, misestimates, CXMT.
segments.zh: 你对中国科技板块有多乐观？因为Cambricorn要发布财报，还有CXMT。

segments.en: It's growth quarter and quarter expected to remain flat as well.
segments.zh: 这是增长季度，预计环比也持平。

segments.en: So do you see any potential, any reason to hold Chinese tech?
segments.zh: 那么你认为有潜力吗？有理由持有中国科技股吗？

segments.en: The reason is valuation. But we also have been a bit more cautious now on Chinese tech.
segments.zh: 理由是估值。但我们现在对中国科技板块也更谨慎一些。

segments.en: And look, Chinese is struggling in terms of growth overall.
segments.zh: 而且，中国整体增长面临压力。

segments.en: Investment cycle is quite weak. I mean, the export is the one thing that really works.
segments.zh: **周期相当疲弱。我的意思是，出口是唯一真正有效的。

segments.en: But most of these investments are really domestic.
And I think there's a very good story around AI capabilities, but it's sort of not coming through.
segments.zh: 我认为人工智能能力方面有很好的故事，但还没有体现出来。

segments.en: And it's a catalyst to unlock that. And it's very hard to see at the moment this catalyst.
segments.zh: 需要催化剂来释放这一点。目前很难看到这个催化剂。

segments.en: So if you have a bit of a longer-term vision, yeah, it's good to have some Chinese AI exposure.
segments.zh: 所以如果你有较长远的眼光，是的，配置一些中国人工智能资产是好的。

segments.en: But for a tactical trade, it probably at the moment not enough.
segments.zh: 但作为战术性交易，目前可能还不够。

segments.en: What's going to be that catalyst, though?
